categories_thin: Siding and window specialists - few Old Bridge-based firms; most hits are regional companies that only market to the township.
Locksmiths - nearly every page ranking for 'locksmith Old Bridge' is a keyword-domain lead generator; only two had their own branded site.
Security installers - one credible local firm (BGS Security) plus one unverified record.

Towing - the township publishes a licensed-wrecker ordinance, not a current operator list, so entries come from web advertising plus one local business page; only one operator (First Due) has an in-town street address and it also works out of Monroe.
Moving and storage - very few in-town independent movers; self-storage in Old Bridge is all national chains (Extra Space, Public Storage, U-Haul) and therefore excluded.
Independent tire shops - the Old Bridge tire market is dominated by Mavis, Mr. Tire and Walmart, all chains and excluded; the remaining tire sellers are also general repair shops.

Painting - re-run during revision; several names came back but most (Blue Sky, JPS, F.J. Reale) exist only in Yellow Pages, so depth beyond the four firms with their own sites is realistically unavailable without calling.

Septic / sewer and drain - re-run during revision; the township has only a handful of firms with in-town addresses, and two of them (Central Jersey Septic, Giglio's) are the same handful that appear on every directory.
Cleaning, landscaping and handyman trades - dominated by owner-operators visible on only one directory, so counts are well below reality.
caveats: Yellow Pages, BBB, Cylex, Manta, D&B, SuperPages, BuildZoom, ChamberOfCommerce.com, Thumbtack, GAF, AllPages and DuckDuckGo returned HTTP 403/CAPTCHA to direct fetching; information attributed to those sources comes from search-engine snippets for those exact URLs, so details need re-verification.
Google Maps served only a 'limited view' (11 results per query, no infinite scroll), so Maps was not used for enumeration.
OpenStreetMap/Overpass API timed out on multiple endpoints and was abandoned.
Many entries are companies whose websites market to Old Bridge but whose base town is unconfirmed; notes flag these as service-area businesses so triage can drop them if they are outside the zone.
No website was recorded unless it was opened or clearly linked from a listing.

Removed in this revision: SERVPRO of Old Bridge/Cranbury and ASP (America's Swimming Pool Company) as franchise brands, American Tire & Auto Care as an eight-store chain, 'Windows, Siding and Roofing in Old Bridge' as an unverifiable keyword name, 'Old Bridge Towing' as a lead-capture site, and Gary Dominicus & Son because its published address is in East Brunswick, outside the zone.

Two borderline multi-location independents (Hometown Pool Supply, Worldwide Flooring Design Center) are kept and flagged in notes rather than dropped, since the exclusion rule targets franchise and national chains.
data_gaps: No complete, publicly accessible list of licensed contractors or NJ-registered home-improvement contractors filtered to Old Bridge could be retrieved; the Division of Consumer Affairs lookup is interactive only.
Old Bridge Township economic development / business directory pages were not located or not reachable, and the township publishes only the wrecker ordinance, not a current licensed-wrecker list.
The Old Bridge-area chamber of commerce domain did not resolve (oldbridgechamber.com), so no member directory was obtainable.
Group C coverage is a best-effort union of directories and search results, not a verified census; expect a meaningful undercount (roughly 30-50%) of one-person contractor operations.
Phones are missing for many entries because the underlying directories do not expose them without opening each individual profile page.
BuildZoom contractor pages (used for several license/address details) return 403 to direct fetching, so those fields rest on search-result snippets.

C&R Inspired Landscaping's Matawan street address and Hometown Pool Supply's / Worldwide Flooring's full store lists were reported by the verifier but could not be re-confirmed on pages that would open, so they are recorded as reported-not-verified.
